svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Features menu C: Workbench
svg.desc: Alternative C for the features menu: a paper workbench sheet over the dimmed Recommendations page. Eight step tiles each preview their screen (class bar, ranked parts, bin wall, pick group, best rail, open recommendations, before/after numbers, a printed move list) with state and counts; a Next up card, plans and settings, stage-2 slots and the keyboard box.
